div.head: VIII Atr 10.1
div.ab: ⁊ se þe þæt nelle gelæstan, sille þar to eacan XXX p' ⁊ gilde þam cyninge CXX scill'.
⁊ se þe þæt nelle gelæstan, sille þar to eacan XXX p' ⁊ gilde þam cyninge CXX scill'.
And se þe þæt nelle gelæstan sille þartoeacan XXX pæniga and gilde þam cyninge CXX scillinga.
Und wer es zu leisten weigert, zahle 30 Pfennig ausserdem und zahle dem König 120 Schilling.
And whoever refuses to pay it, let him give 30 pence in addition and pay the king 120 shillings.
And he who refuses to render it shall give in addition 30 pence, and shall pay 120 shillings to the king.
And anyone who refuses to pay them are to give an additional thirty pence and pay one hundred and twenty shillings to the king.
